headline: Interactive Brokers Opens AI Connectivity to Any Tool Built on the MCP Standard
summary: GREENWICH, Conn., July 28, 2026--Interactive Brokers (Nasdaq: IBKR) today announced that clients can now connect their accounts to nearly any AI tool they already use.
